text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Electric Power Authority is considering legal action against individuals and communities that have accused its workers of extorting money.
- Central Bank of Nigeria has commended Afribank for consistently providing credit to farmers over the last two years.
- Nigerian Ports Plc has begun rehabilitation of cargo handling plants in a battle to become the principal port in the West and Central Africa region.

- The central bank has directed banks to open sub head-offices in the administrative capital, Abuja. Sources said the aim was to reduce the problem of transactions with banks which retain their bases in the commercial capital Lagos, and to increase economic activity in Abuja.
